units.source_text: 伯父来探望父亲的时候，父亲总是一再挽留，不让他走。

en.t: Whenever my uncle came to visit my father, Father always urged him again and again to stay and would not let him leave.
Stay a little longer, will you? I feel terribly lonely.

units.source_text: 这好像是父亲的主要理由。

en.t: This seemed to be Father's main reason.

units.source_text: 而他向伯父诉苦，说母亲和我不给他想吃的东西，似乎也是他的目的之一。

en.t: And one of his purposes also seemed to be to complain to my uncle that Mother and I would not give him the things he wanted to eat.
